# scripts/ops/New-AvdMcpConfig.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Generates a read-only, zero-secret .mcp.json file for interactive AVD operator investigation in Azure Cloud Shell, a local workstation, or the VNet operator jumpbox.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-Namespace` | string[] | no | `@('virtualdesktop', 'monitor', 'kusto', 'advisor', 'pricing', 'resourcehealth', 'policy', 'role', 'quota')` |  |
| `-IncludeAzCliMcp` | switch | no |  | Include Microsoft's Azure CLI MCP Server (Azure/azure-api-mcp) locked to --readonly. |
| `-OutputPath` | string | no |  | File path to write .mcp.json. If omitted, returns the configuration hashtable. |
